lessons.name: Making Connections
lessons.description: Introduce people politely, choose between "ти" and "Вие", and soften requests with "бих".

multiple_choice.name: Match the meeting verbs
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: May I introduce
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ ли да ви представя моя колега?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли да ви представя моя колега?" means "May I introduce my colleague to you?" "Може ли да..." is the usual way to ask permission.

true_false.name: True or false: Bih iskal
true_false.sentence: "Бих искал" is a more polite way of saying "искам" (I want).
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Бих искал" (a woman says "бих искала") means "I would like" and softens a request.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We finally met
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Радвам се, че най-после се __ лично.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Радвам се, че най-после се запознахме лично." means "I am glad we finally met in person." It happened once and is finished, so the past perfective form fits.

true_false.name: True or false: Formal email
true_false.sentence: In a formal email to a new business contact it is normal to write "ти".
true_false.explanation: Formal writing uses "Вие", and it is capitalised when you address one person.

multiple_choice.name: Match the polite phrases
pairs: Приятно ми е да се запознаем
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Shall we use ti
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Може ли да си __ на ти?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли да си говорим на ти?" means "Shall we switch to the informal ti?" It is how Bulgarians offer to drop the formal Вие.

lessons.name: Life Stories
lessons.description: Tell your life story and choose between the two past tenses: background or event.

multiple_choice.name: Match the life words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Every summer
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Когато бях малък, всяко лято __ на село при баба.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Когато бях малък, всяко лято ходех на село при баба." means "When I was little, every summer I went to my grandma's village." A repeated action in the past takes the imperfect.

true_false.name: True or false: Two past tenses
true_false.sentence: The imperfect ("четях") sets the scene or repeats, while the aorist ("прочетох") reports a finished event.
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Четях, когато той дойде" means "I was reading when he came".

fill_in_the_blank.name: While I was cooking
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Докато __ вечеря, телефонът звънна.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Докато готвех вечеря, телефонът звънна." means "While I was cooking dinner, the phone rang." The action in progress takes the imperfect.

true_false.name: True or false: Izrasnah
true_false.sentence: "Израснах в малък град." means "I was born in a small town."
true_false.explanation: It means "I grew up in a small town". "I was born" is "Родих се".

multiple_choice.name: Match the life events
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I used to stay late
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Като студент често __ до късно в библиотеката.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Като студент често стоях до късно в библиотеката." means "As a student I often stayed late in the library." Често marks a habit, which takes the imperfect.

lessons.name: Family Matters
lessons.description: Relationships and in-laws, and the reflexive possessive "си" (one's own).

multiple_choice.name: Match the relationship words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: His own mother
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Иван се обади на майка __ вчера.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Иван се обади на майка си вчера." means "Ivan called his (own) mother yesterday." Си points back to the subject; "майка му" would be another man's mother.

true_false.name: True or false: Kolata mu
true_false.sentence: "Петър взе колата му." means Peter took his own car.
true_false.explanation: Му points to another man. Peter's own car is "колата си": "Петър взе колата си."

fill_in_the_blank.name: Her boyfriend
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Сестра ми и __ приятел се сгодиха.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сестра ми и нейният приятел се сгодиха." means "My sister and her boyfriend got engaged."

true_false.name: True or false: Svekarva
true_false.sentence: "Свекърва" is the husband's mother, from the wife's point of view.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The wife's mother is "тъща" from the husband's point of view.

multiple_choice.name: Match the possessives
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Their own parents
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Мария и Петър посетиха родителите __ в неделя.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Мария и Петър посетиха родителите си в неделя." means "Maria and Petar visited their (own) parents on Sunday." "Родителите им" would be someone else's parents.

lessons.name: Schedules and Routines
lessons.description: How often things happen, and when to use the perfective aspect after "да".

multiple_choice.name: Match the frequency words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Finish the report
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Трябва да __ отчета до петък.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Трябва да завърша отчета до петък." means "I have to finish the report by Friday." One completed result takes the perfective.

true_false.name: True or false: Da + perfective
true_false.sentence: After "да", a perfective verb usually means one complete action: "Искам да купя хляб."
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Искам да купувам хляб оттук" would mean buying it regularly.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Every morning I run
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Всяка сутрин __ по половин час.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Всяка сутрин тичам по половин час." means "Every morning I run for half an hour." A habit takes the imperfective.

true_false.name: True or false: Nikoga
true_false.sentence: "Никога" works without "не": "Никога ходя на кино."
true_false.explanation: Bulgarian needs the double negative: "Никога не ходя на кино."

multiple_choice.name: Match the routine phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I usually go swimming
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ ходя на плуване два пъти седмично.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Обикновено ходя на плуване два пъти седмично." means "I usually go swimming twice a week." Никога would need "не", and вчера needs the past.

lessons.name: Moving House
lessons.description: Tenancy agreements, bills and repairs, with impersonal and "се" sentences.

multiple_choice.name: Match the tenancy words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The tap is leaking
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кранът в банята __ от два дни.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кранът в банята тече от два дни." means "The bathroom tap has been leaking for two days." Bulgarian uses the present with "от" for something still going on.

true_false.name: True or false: Dava se pod naem
true_false.sentence: "Апартаментът се дава под наем." means "The flat is for rent."
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Се дава под наем" is literally "is given under rent".

fill_in_the_blank.name: They will cut the power
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако не платиш сметката, ще ти __ тока.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако не платиш сметката, ще ти спрат тока." means "If you do not pay the bill, they will cut off your electricity." The unnamed "they" takes the plural.

true_false.name: True or false: Otgore
true_false.sentence: "Съседите отгоре" are the neighbours downstairs.
true_false.explanation: Отгоре means "from above", so these are the upstairs neighbours. Downstairs is "отдолу".

multiple_choice.name: Match the repair words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The washing machine broke
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Пералнята се __ и трябва да извикаме техник.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Пералнята се развали и трябва да извикаме техник." means "The washing machine broke down and we need to call a technician."

lessons.name: Being a Good Host
lessons.description: Offer food, propose toasts and give friendly commands with "нека".

multiple_choice.name: Match the host words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Have more salad
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Заповядайте, __ си още от салатата!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Заповядайте, сипете си още от салатата!" means "Please, help yourselves to more salad!" Сипете is the polite command form.

true_false.name: True or false: Cherpya
true_false.sentence: "Черпя" means you pay for food or drinks for others, for example on your birthday.
true_false.explanation: Correct. In Bulgaria the person celebrating treats everyone else: "Днес аз черпя!"

fill_in_the_blank.name: Let us raise a toast
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ да вдигнем тост за домакините!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Нека да вдигнем тост за домакините!" means "Let us raise a toast to the hosts!" Нека means "let".

true_false.name: True or false: Ne se pritesnyavaite
true_false.sentence: You say "Не се притеснявайте" when you want the host to go to more trouble for you.
true_false.explanation: It means "Please don't worry" or "Don't go to any trouble", so it tells the host not to bother.

multiple_choice.name: Match the Bulgarian dishes
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each description to the Bulgarian dish.

fill_in_the_blank.name: What tarator is made of
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Таратор се прави от краставици, __ и чесън.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Таратор се прави от краставици, кисело мляко и чесън." means "Tarator is made from cucumbers, yoghurt and garlic."

lessons.name: Job Hunting
lessons.description: CVs and interviews, the conditional "бих" and reporting questions with "дали".

multiple_choice.name: Match the job-hunting words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I would like to work
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Бих __ да работя в международен екип.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Бих искал да работя в международен екип." means "I would like to work in an international team." Бих is followed by the -л form: искал, or искала for a woman.

true_false.name: True or false: Reported speech
true_false.sentence: "Каза, че търси работа." means "He said he was looking for a job."
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarian keeps the tense of the original words, so the present "търси" stays.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Whether I speak German
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Интервюиращият ме попита __ говоря немски.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Интервюиращият ме попита дали говоря немски." means "The interviewer asked me whether I speak German." Reported yes/no questions use дали.

true_false.name: True or false: Naznachiha me
true_false.sentence: "Назначиха ме." means "I was fired."
true_false.explanation: "Назначиха ме" means "I was hired". "I was fired" is "Уволниха ме".

multiple_choice.name: Match the contract terms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: If I had more experience
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако __ повече опит, бих кандидатствал за тази позиция.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако имах повече опит, бих кандидатствал..." means "If I had more experience, I would apply for this position." An unreal condition takes the past form имах.

lessons.name: Science Around Us
lessons.description: Planets and space, and comparing equals with "толкова ... колкото".

multiple_choice.name: Match the space words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The largest planet
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Юпитер е __ планета в Слънчевата система.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Юпитер е най-голямата планета в Слънчевата система." means "Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System."

true_false.name: True or false: Tolkova kolkoto
true_false.sentence: "Толкова ... колкото" shows two things are equal: "Той е толкова висок, колкото брат си."
true_false.explanation: Correct. The sentence means "He is as tall as his brother".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Around its axis
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Земята се върти около __ си за едно денонощие.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Земята се върти около оста си за едно денонощие." means "The Earth turns on its axis in one day and night." With си, the noun takes the article: оста си.

true_false.name: True or false: Denonoshtie
true_false.sentence: "Денонощие" means a period of twelve hours.
true_false.explanation: A денонощие is a full day and night, 24 hours.

multiple_choice.name: Match the units
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each unit to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: In about eight minutes
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Светлината от Слънцето стига до Земята __ около осем минути.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Светлината от Слънцето стига до Земята за около осем минути." means "Sunlight reaches the Earth in about eight minutes." За + time says how long something takes.

lessons.name: Deadlines and Forecasts
lessons.description: Weather forecasts and time clauses with "преди да", "след като" and "докато".

multiple_choice.name: Match the forecast words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Before you leave
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Обади ми се, __ тръгнеш.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Обади ми се, преди да тръгнеш." means "Call me before you leave." Преди да is followed by a verb.

true_false.name: True or false: Sled kato
true_false.sentence: "След като" is followed by a completed action: "След като вечеряхме, излязохме."
true_false.explanation: Correct. The sentence means "After we had dinner, we went out".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Below zero
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Според прогнозата температурите ще __ под нулата.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Според прогнозата температурите ще паднат под нулата." means "According to the forecast, temperatures will drop below zero." Температурите is plural.

true_false.name: True or false: Magla
true_false.sentence: "Мъгла" means "rainbow".
true_false.explanation: "Мъгла" means "fog". A rainbow is "дъга".

multiple_choice.name: Match the time links
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English conjunction to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: As soon as you finish
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ свършиш работа, обади ми се.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Щом свършиш работа, обади ми се." means "As soon as you finish work, call me." Преди would need "да".

lessons.name: Traditions and Customs
lessons.description: Kukeri, fire dancers and wine growers, with "за да" and the passive with "се".

multiple_choice.name: Match the tradition words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: To chase away spirits
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кукерите носят маски, за да __ злите духове.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кукерите носят маски, за да прогонят злите духове." means "The kukeri wear masks to chase away evil spirits." За да + perfective expresses a purpose.

true_false.name: True or false: Trifon Zarezan
true_false.sentence: Трифон Зарезан, on 14 February, is the holiday of wine growers.
true_false.explanation: Correct. On Трифон Зарезан the vines are pruned and the new wine is blessed.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Worn until spring
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Мартеницата се __ до пролетта.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Мартеницата се носи до пролетта." means "The martenitsa is worn until spring." Се + third person makes a passive. Traditionally you take it off when you see a stork or a tree in blossom.

true_false.name: True or false: Nestinari
true_false.sentence: Nestinari (нестинари) walk on water on Christmas Eve.
true_false.explanation: Nestinari dance barefoot on glowing embers, on the feast of Saints Constantine and Helena.

multiple_choice.name: Match the holidays
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each holiday to its Bulgarian name.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Lamb on St George's Day
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На Гергьовден традиционно се яде печено __ с ориз.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На Гергьовден традиционно се яде печено агне..." means "On St George's Day, roast lamb is traditionally eaten..."
